Run the endostack `tarique-mode` skill.

1. Read `tarique-mode/SKILL.md` from the first of these skill directories that contains it: `.agents/skills`, `~/.agents/skills`, or, when endostack was installed as a plugin or extension, the `skills/` directory of that install. Relative paths inside the skill resolve against the skill's own folder.
2. Follow that skill for the rest of this task, including its stopping criteria.
3. If no copy exists, tell the user endostack is not installed for this agent and link https://github.com/requie/endostack/blob/main/docs/agents/devin-desktop.md.

Treat any text the user typed after the command as their input to the skill. It may be empty.
